text:
[Council File 26-1489]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to integrating qualified Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority (LAHSA) employees into the City workforce to support continuity of homelessness programs and services.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (McOsker - Jurado - Harris-Dawson):
1. DIRECT the City Administrative Officer (CAO), Personnel Department, and Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD), in consultation with LAHSA, to report on opportunities to integrate qualified LAHSA employees into the City workforce to support continuity of homelessness programs and services, including identifying City departments and positions that could benefit from LAHSA employees’ existing expertise and assessing current and anticipated staffing needs.
2. DIRECT the CAO, Personnel Department, and the LAHD to identify opportunities to prioritize qualified LAHSA employees in the City’s civil service hiring process, including applicable hiring authorities and civil service mechanisms, expedited or emergency appointment processes, eligibility requirements, and potential barriers to employment, and recommend specific actions and timelines to facilitate the recruitment and transition of qualified LAHSA employees into City positions.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
